description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to article generation. The chart contains three slices, representing “Task,” “Article editing,” and “Headline generation.” The largest slice, labeled “Task,” is red and occupies approximately 83% of the chart. “Article editing” is represented by a blue slice and is labeled with 14.6%, while “Headline generation” is shown as a small, yellow slice labeled with 2.4%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within the “Article editing” and “Headline generation” slices. There is no visible legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding. The slices appear ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and proceeding to the smallest.
